_about: Fixed text the Anvil plugin ships with, loaded once at startUp (AnvilPlugin.ShippedText).

alwaysNotify: prestige items always posted to the rare-drops channel regardless of value/rarity — usually untradeable or cheap but a big deal. Matched as case-insensitive substrings, so 'Blessed dizana's quiver' still matches 'dizana's quiver'. pluginConfig.alwaysNotifyItems extends it without a plugin update. Prestige capes/quivers (awarded, untradeable); raid ornament/colour kits + dusts (untradeable — ToB/CoX/ToA); ToA reward-chest cosmetics (Menaphite ornament kit, Cursed phalanx, Masori crafting kit); DT2 untradeable uniques (the ring vestiges, all caught by 'vestige', the chromium-ingot quartz, the four Soulreaper axe pieces); boss collection-log jars + Champions' Challenge scroll/cape; enhanced crystal seeds (Gauntlet weapon seed and Elf-pickpocket teleport seed); Vyrewatch blood shard (tradeable, but its GE price dips below the value floor) + the Fight Caves fire cape.
funDeaths: fallback fun-death lines, used only when the server pool (pluginConfig.funDeathMessages) is empty. {name} is replaced with the RSN.
deathTaunts: short reaction lines appended to every death post (pluginConfig.deathTaunts overrides).
spoonTaunts: reaction lines appended to a notably lucky (rare / high-value) drop (pluginConfig.spoonTaunts overrides).

grandmasterQuests / masterQuests: quest difficulty tiers for completion announcements, verified against the OSRS Wiki quest list (2026-07). Only the top tiers are listed: a quest absent from both counts as below Master, so it only posts on the 'All quests' setting. Lowercase, matched against the parsed scroll name; some entries cover scroll names that omit a numeral or subtitle. The wiki tiers RFD as 'Special'; defeating the Culinaromancer is the de-facto final completion (Barrows gloves), so it is announced with the Masters. Update when Jagex ships new Master+ quests.
